gates.check: Every requested workflow has an implementation or explicit open decision.
Cross-tenant screen, API, export, search, analytics and error paths are denied.
Same source event and repeated file do not duplicate posted records.
Refund/cancel retains original event and a separately auditable reversal.
Representative cases match hand-calculated contract rules and rounding.
Official docs, owner permission, sandbox evidence, signature/retry rules and source IDs are recorded.
No secrets in repository/database/logs and no unnecessary customer data collected.
Bad imports are rejected atomically; valid retries are idempotent.
Persistent data backup restores successfully to an isolated test environment.
A non-specialist can run daily tasks, month close and common error recovery from the manual.
Named operator approves deploy, data migration, external access and money-related policy.
